denominator: 37 stable semantic feature families; overlapping source surfaces are counted separately, never added or weighted

families.name: TLA+ grammar and lossless parsing
families.acceptance: Pinned grammar acceptance/rejection, spans, malformed input and full syntax corpus; retain the distinction between grammar and module loading.

families.name: Semantic resolution, levels and module/proof syntax
families.acceptance: Full pinned SANY acceptance and error-code cases, nested/local INSTANCE, recursive and higher-order scopes; matching oracle crashes remain classified separately.

families.name: Configuration parsing
families.acceptance: Field-level agreement for all 22 keyword spellings, values, substitutions, duplicates and malformed files. Parsing a keyword does not certify its backend.

families.name: Model/configuration binding and startup
families.acceptance: Match constant replacement, property splitting, startup effects and deciding error order for all configuration services.

families.name: Values, equality, order, laziness and representation
families.acceptance: All value classes and constructor-sensitive equality, normalization, enumeration, print and errors; both profiles including integer overflow and canonical ordering.

families.name: Evaluation scopes, recursion and higher-order operators
families.acceptance: Lazy scalar/action/temporal/operator parameters, LET, nested INSTANCE and substitutions retain levels and caller scope through evaluation and validation.

families.name: Finite domains, successor enumeration and independent ENABLED
families.acceptance: Explicit and finite lazy domains preserve TLC successor order and duplicates; independent finite covers decide ENABLED/deadlock, including scope and closing edges.

families.name: Native override discovery and installation
families.acceptance: Audit all 158 registered bindings and installation order, annotation calling modes, inheritance and substitution; provide native custom registration. Registry metadata is not implementation evidence.

families.name: Standard-module operators
families.acceptance: All executable definitions in the 20 standard modules, their active overrides and supported/error cases; unsupported Reals or other non-executable expressions match TLC rejection instead of fabricating values.

families.name: CommunityModules operators and TLA+ fallback definitions
families.acceptance: Census and differential controls for all 34 pinned source modules, every active override and evaluation fallback; no completion claim from 651/767 ASSUMEs.

families.name: Error classes, construction provenance and precedence
families.acceptance: Resolve all ten unverified construction-dependent contexts; positive, invalid argument and simultaneous-error controls verify deciding code, class, phase and text.

families.name: Sequential BFS safety, invariants and deadlock
families.acceptance: Complete and mid-level stops match generated/distinct counts, depth, violated property and independently validated traces, including empty Init/Next and duplicates.

families.name: Deterministic parallel checking and runtime-sensitive fallbacks
families.acceptance: Worker/chaos equivalence extends from safety to temporal/symmetry; runtime-sensitive sequential fallback and requested/actual worker information remain truthful.

families.name: Fingerprint/exact stores and collision accounting
families.acceptance: Bit-exact TLC stream, safe default mixing, exact identity and probabilities; forced collisions, symmetry/VIEW keys, spill and replay produce no silent state loss.

families.name: State/action constraints and action-property split
families.acceptance: Filtering/check timing and stop counts match all constraint combinations, including safety versus phase-L graph edges and continuation.

families.name: VIEW identity and temporal lifting
families.acceptance: Match VIEW identity, representative order and printed views; prove closing transitions or retain sufficient concrete lifting evidence. Do not construct a false temporal word from quotient representatives.

families.name: Symmetry declaration binding, warnings and closure
families.acceptance: Match lookup snapshot, source-aware warning images, disabled-group heuristics, error order and closure; malformed maps reject by default and follow TLC under compat.

families.name: Symmetry reduction, concrete traces and audit
families.acceptance: All 11 selected symmetry models agree in both stores/widths; canonical keys, symmetry-before-VIEW, retained concrete paths and optional audit. Default liveness is wholly unreduced; compat reproduces labeled TLC quotient behavior.

families.name: Temporal language, simplification and exact tableaux
families.acceptance: All 53 selected temporal models plan without feature refusal; exact DNF, EA/AE classification, branch grouping and tableau numbering match Java controls.

families.name: Temporal graph capture and phase-L timing
families.acceptance: Actual parallel graph retention, duplicate/stutter edges, constraints, atom evaluation and stopping/error precedence match pinned probes; post-capture failures retain truthful stage and work evidence.

families.name: WF/SF fairness and independent periodic validation
families.acceptance: Complete WF/SF, temporal operators and scoped ENABLED cases; validate every claimed property, fair cycle and closing edge independently, rejecting altered predicates/claims.

families.name: SCC acceptance, TLC lasso selection and attribution
families.acceptance: Ordinary strict checking reproduces fixed-polynomial TLC SCC/hash/order and lasso/ending selection; default short witnesses retain independent validation and registered attribution differences.

families.name: Periodic/final/off/sequential liveness schedules
families.acceptance: Every accepted lncheck variant has matching enable/stop behavior; test TLC wall-clock decisions separately from deterministic level-boundary defaults, recording volatile fields.

families.name: Simulation, generation, scheduling and random replay
families.acceptance: Initial/action choice, trace count/depth, seeded/aril draws, all simulation schedulers, constraints/properties and termination match mode-specific controls; stable default replay survives worker changes.

families.name: DFID checking
families.acceptance: Depth iterations, visited-state status, stop/deadlock/continuation and counts match finite and infinite bounded controls; reports distinguish DFID from BFS.

families.name: Granted environment, file and process effects
families.acceptance: Off without explicit category grants even in compat; granted behavior, serialization/CSV/JSON and process errors match oracle, with external inputs captured for replay.

families.name: Runtime introspection and configuration services
families.acceptance: Complete TLCGet/Set, traces, PickSuccessor, deferred calls, periodic hooks, possible counts, RL reward and postconditions at their correct phases. Errors never invent worker use or success.

families.name: CLI/output conventions and message controls
families.acceptance: All 46 flag spellings, aliases, nested arguments and invalid combinations are mapped/tested; reproduce tool/human codes, exits, suppression/escalation, terse/diff output and startup ordering.

families.name: Trace/state dumps, ALIAS and trace exploration
families.acceptance: TLC trace loading, generated trace specs, binary/JSON/state/DOT dumps, ALIAS and exploration preserve evaluation side effects; retain clean oracle run when dumpTrace perturbs overrides.

families.name: Coverage and debugger services
families.acceptance: Native coverage reports and debugger stepping/breakpoints/stack/inspection preserve evaluation results; match all relevant coverage and debugger controls.

families.name: Bounded-memory stores, frontiers, graphs and SCC spill
families.acceptance: Tiny-budget forced spill equals in-memory runs for values, counts, stop order and traces; resource failure is explicit with truthful partial evidence.

families.name: Native checkpoint and recovery
families.acceptance: Versioned native checkpoints include model/profile identity, queues, stores, temporal graph, streams and committed effects; interruptions/resume equal uninterrupted runs. Java checkpoint import is excluded.

families.name: Native distributed checking and recovery
families.acceptance: Native coordinator/workers reproduce local ordered results under task retries, lost workers and reassignment, without duplicate counts/effects. Java RMI interoperability is excluded.

families.name: PlusCal translation and translation validation
families.acceptance: Both syntaxes, all 21 option spellings, process/procedure/label/atomic/fairness semantics, translations/checksums/source maps and diagnostics match pinned translator cases; translated models check equivalently.

families.name: Public Rust APIs and cargo-test integration
families.acceptance: Resolved options, checking/simulation/translation/checkpoint/distribution APIs and versioned reports share one implementation; standalone validator cannot enable the enumerator.

families.name: Complete corpus, harness and release certification
families.acceptance: Complete selected-case census and generated goldens for model/feature interactions; no unknown, timeout, malformed report, feature refusal or pending validation is disguised as agreement.
families.notes: Relative implementation executable paths resolve before child model directories change; launch-path regression is covered. Corpus and release certification remain partial.

families.name: Global TLC profile and approved better defaults
families.acceptance: Every implemented option declares/testing its TLC counterpart; mixed runs are labeled and expected divergences cannot excuse wrong verdicts. Category host grants remain the approved exception.
